item_name: Special Treatments, Procedures, and Programs — Z1. None of the above

lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: The observation window differs by column. Column b (While a Resident) uses the last 14 days (and/or since admission/entry or reentry), which is the item's stated look-back period ("14-day look-back period," p. O-2). Column a (On Admission) uses days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B, and Column c (At Discharge) uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C (p. O-3). lookback_days is recorded as 14 for the While a Resident column; the 3-day column windows are recorded as a conflict/coexistence below.

coding_levels.label: None of the above — On Admission
coding_levels.definition: Check Z, None of the above, if no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period (days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B).

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

coding_levels.label: None of the above — While a Resident
coding_levels.definition: Check Z, None of the above, if no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

coding_levels.label: None of the above — At Discharge
coding_levels.definition: Check Z, None of the above, if no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the 3-day assessment period (last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C).

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code O0110Z1 (None of the above) if none of the treatments, procedures, or programs listed in O0110 were received or performed by the resident.

source.quote:
O0110Z1, None of the above
Code if none of the above treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed by the resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For Column a (On Admission), check Z, None of the above, if no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period (days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B).

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B. If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For Column b (While a Resident), check Z, None of the above, if no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: For Column c (At Discharge), check Z, None of the above, if no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When determining whether any O0110 treatment applies (and therefore whether Z1 is checked), treatments, programs and procedures the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff may be coded; services provided solely in conjunction with a surgical or diagnostic procedure (e.g., IV medications or ventilators), including routine pre- and post-operative procedures, are not coded.

source.quote: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff. Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators. Surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

federal_coding_rules.rule: O0110 is completed by checking all of the treatments, procedures, and programs that were performed within the assessment period defined for each column (a. On Admission, b. While a Resident, c. At Discharge); Z1 has a checkbox in all three columns.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

source.quote: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

federal.notes: Stated as the Steps for Assessment for O0110; medical-record review is the evidence basis for checking (or not checking) Z1.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages for O0110/O0110Z1 do not tie this item to a payment or case-mix classification. Assessment periods reference the SNF PPS Stay (A2400B/A2400C), but no payment or case-mix grouping effect is stated for Z1.

conflicts.topic: Coexisting observation windows for O0110 (14 days vs. 3-day column windows)

positions.claim: Column b (While a Resident) uses a 14-day look-back: treatments performed after admission/entry or reentry and within the last 14 days; Z is checked if none occurred in that window.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

positions.claim: Columns a and c use 3-day assessment periods (days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C); Z is checked if none occurred in the 3-day assessment period.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

positions.claim: The Item Rationale describes the item as having a "14-day look-back period."

source.quote: Reevaluation of special treatments and procedures the resident received or performed, or programs that the resident was involved in during the 14-day look-back period is important to ensure the continued appropriateness of the treatments, procedures, or programs.

conflicts.resolution: Resolved by the document itself: the manual states the assessment period is "defined for each column" (p. O-3) — 3 days for columns a and c, 14 days (or since admission/entry/reentry) for column b. The 14-day figure in the Item Rationale corresponds to the While a Resident column.
